status: User rejects partial sample; creative consistency gate failed
user_feedback: Exterior scenario jumps and an eye problem around ten seconds; questions continuing Flow because consistency requires too much trial and error.
supersedes: Initial recommendation for another whole-scene fixed-pose/ambient-motion Flow pilot; prior saved operator reviews remain historical evidence, not user approval.

inspection.method: Read-only FFmpeg 9.0.2 frame extraction and Pillow contact sheets; visual inspection of every frame from output 233 through 244 via source frames 53 through 64, plus before/after frames at all five cuts.
inspection.eye_observation: Eyes are open at output frame 238 / native source frame 58 and closed at output frame 239 / native source frame 59. Abrupt transition near 9.92–9.96 seconds exists in the native clip.

source_comparison.note: Frame extraction and source comparison only; no source, project, or export mutation.

inspection.exterior_observation: At frames 360 (15s) and 720 (30s), the district is replaced while the interior and camera framing remain nearly the same. At 180, 540 and 900 frames, wide/medium changes use independently generated scenery rather than a shared continuous exterior timeline.
inspection.interpretation: Both whole-scene generative variation and the chosen editorial layout contribute. This review does not establish that every within-shot exterior frame is clean.

recommendation.whole_scene_flow: Do not continue it as the production foundation for the required low-iteration consistency; further generation is held.
recommendation.alternative: Prepare reusable character/interior assets and authored eye/pose motion, with a separately composed exterior timeline shared by all camera framings; plan district transitions explicitly.
recommendation.flow_role: Optional independently usable scenery/concept assets, subject to review; no new request submitted.
limits: Alternative is a proposal, not an implemented or approved route.
Up-front artwork separation and animation preparation are required.
Matching the preferred Flow appearance and motion with existing material is unproven.
Previous rejected Blender/SPAR3D/parts-rig trials are not revived.
No new generator, model, dependency, subscription, asset purchase or credit use.

official_feature_check.finding: Current support page lists first and first/last Frames to Video for Veo 3.1 Quality, but not Ingredients/References, Video to Video editing or Extend for that model. No new model is selected. The workflow recommendation is based on this trial and user feedback, not a claim that all Flow uses are incapable of consistency.

preservation: Source, project and export files were not edited; only read-only QA images and review documentation were added. Existing software acceptance results remain valid for technical behavior, not creative approval.
